page_topic_one_liner: Website structure SEO — IA hierarchy, flat architecture, internal linking, navigation, and crawl depth optimization
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional information architecture SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show a site hierarchy tree with hub-and-spoke internal link flow and shallow click depth — NOT an AI chat panel or generic sitemap XML file.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Site IA tree diagram — root Homepage node branching to 4 first-level hubs (Blog, Products, Docs, About), each with 2-3 child page nodes; accent internal-link arrows flowing from homepage through hubs to deep pages; click-depth counter showing ≤3 clicks badge on leaf nodes
Secondary: flat vs deep hierarchy contrast — wide shallow tree (good, highlighted) vs narrow deep ladder (dimmed, crossed)
Tertiary: breadcrumb trail mockup Home > Category > Page beneath tree root
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is site architecture not GEO)
XML sitemap file as hero (that belongs to sitemap page)
Generic wireframe without hierarchy depth concept
